meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把一份文档变成可爱的 NotebookLM 幻灯片 PDF,存到源文件旁(如 xxx-slides.pdf),并上传到 WOWerpoint 服务器,给你一个手机端分享链接。生成约需 10 分钟,不会卡住对话。
howto.when: 当你说出「Wowerpoint <文件>」、「把这份报告做成幻灯片」等,或要求把单个文档渲染成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。生成前需要先完成一次性的登录授权。

say.note: 生成幻灯片 PDF,并给出手机分享链接

say.text: 把 reports/q3.md 做成幻灯片
用可爱角色讲这份文档的故事
say.note: 你给的提示词会原样传入,不扩写

howto.what_en: Claude turns one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF, saves it next to the source as <stem>-slides.pdf, and uploads it to the WOWerpoint Server to return a mobile share URL. Generation takes ~10 minutes.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", or "turn this report into slides" — any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.note: Builds the slide-deck PDF and returns a share URL

say_en.text: Make a slide deck about reports/q3.md
say_en.note: Runs in the background, about 10 minutes

say_en.text: Turn this report into kawaii slides
say_en.note: Your own prompt is passed through verbatim
